description: Wellcode Studio provides professional floor plan services that turn property layouts into clear, visually appealing, and marketing-ready designs. From 2D and 3D plans to custom layouts, our accurate floor plans help buyers understand spaces, boost engagement, and accelerate decisions.

work_info.title: What is Floor Plan Design?
descriptions: Floor Plan Design is the creation of detailed, accurate layouts that illustrate the arrangement of rooms, walls, and spaces within a property. These visual guides help buyers, architects, and developers understand the flow, dimensions, and functionality of a space before visiting or constructing it.

list.content: Accurate Measurements & Layouts: Ensuring every room and structural element is precisely represented.
2D & 3D Floor Plans: Offering both flat and three-dimensional views for comprehensive understanding.
Furniture & Fixture Placement: Visualizing interiors with realistic furniture and utility placement.
Dimension Annotation & Labeling: Clearly marking sizes, areas, and room functions for clarity.
Marketing & Presentation Ready: Creating floor plans suitable for listings, brochures, and virtual tours.
